mainEntity.name: Copyfy or Shophunter: which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an ecommerce business from A to Z: AI product research, store analysis, generated pages and visual import to Shopify. Shophunter is better if you only want to spy on Shopify stores and estimate their sales. To launch and run a store without stacking tools, Copyfy wins; for pure Shopify spying, Shophunter remains solid.

No, both sit at the same level: 50$/month at Shophunter, 49€/month at Copyfy. For the same budget Copyfy covers far more ground, since Shophunter focuses on Shopify sales tracking. The 5-day free trial needs no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which has the better product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, thanks to its AI that detects winning products directly and analyzes competitor stores across several sources. Shophunter infers promising products from the sales estimation of Shopify stores: it's precise on Shopify, but narrower. To move quickly toward a product to launch, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, AI pages and Shopify integration. Shophunter keeps the edge on fine sales estimation and ultra-specialized tracking of Shopify stores: if intensive Shopify spying is your core business, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial, plus a 5-day free trial. Shophunter, for its part, offers no free trial: you have to pay from the entry tier. The simplest move is to test Copyfy for free to see whether the suite covers your need.
